rules.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires a shot, of any power, it must have a target that was scanned this very turn and its gun must be pointing at that target within 3.0°; if there is no target, no stale scan (age above 0), or the gun is not aimed, it must not fire.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> ((obs.target matches Some(t) && t.age == 0) && aimed(*obs))

deleted_starters.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.

explanation.headline: Proved: rule S2 holds
explanation.summary: Verus proved S2: the robot only fires when it scanned a target this turn (age 0) and the gun is within the aim tolerance of it. In both battles the robot broke a rule called S3 from turn 2 (55 turns in the open arena, 76 in the city), but S3 was not among the rules Verus checked here, so nothing is shown about it.
